# Sunrise (effect 104) on palette Rainbow at speed 240, intensity 128, colour slots red, blue and
# green, captured from the south controller on segment 2 on 2026-09-27. Above a speed of 120 the
# slider stops being a duration in minutes and becomes a rate, which makes the whole picture a pure
# function of the clock: one 16-bit triangle wave drives it and nothing is accumulated. So the only
# unknown in a captured frame is where that wave had got to, and stepping the clock two milliseconds
# at a time covers every picture it can draw in about 1075 tries. Hex RGB triples, wire order.
